name: Lily Cortez
source:
She might have issues that she doesn't want to reveal to anyone, Lily Cortez has been raised to be a sweet girl. Even tho she is often shown as a shy person, and is often reserved as she doesn't wanna show her emotions to other people, she often spends her time alone, dealing with her weaknesses due to her mother's death.
